from itertools import islice

def chunked_even(iterable, n, B):
    iterable = iter(iterable)
    min_buffer = B
    buffer = list(islice(iterable, min_buffer))
    for _ in islice(map(buffer.append, iterable), n, None, n):
        yield buffer[:n]
        del buffer[:n]
    if not buffer:
        return
    length = len(buffer)
    q, r = divmod(length, n)
    num_lists = q + (1 if r > 0 else 0)
    q, r = divmod(length, num_lists)
    full_size = q + (1 if r > 0 else 0)
    partial_size = full_size - 1
    num_full_lists = r
    for i in range(num_lists):
        size = full_size if i < num_full_lists else partial_size
        yield buffer[i * size : (i + 1) * size]

def check(Bfn, name):
    ok = True
    for N in range(1, 60):
        for n in range(1, N + 2):
            try:
                out = list(chunked_even(range(N), n, Bfn(n)))
            except Exception as e:
                print(name, "EXC", N, n, e); ok=False; continue
            items = [x for l in out for x in l]
            lengths = [len(l) for l in out]
            if items != list(range(N)):
                print(name, "ITEMS", N, n); ok=False
            if any(L < 1 or L > n for L in lengths):
                print(name, "SIZE", N, n, lengths); ok=False
            if lengths and max(lengths)-min(lengths) > 1:
                print(name, "EVEN", N, n, lengths); ok=False
    print(name, "OK" if ok else "FAIL")

def chunked_even(iterable, n, B):

    for _ in islice(map(buffer.append, iterable), n, None, n):
        yield buffer[:n]
        del buffer[:n]
    if not buffer:
        return
    length = len(buffer)
    q, r = divmod(length, n)
    num_lists = q + (1 if r > 0 else 0)
    q, r = divmod(length, num_lists)
    full_size = q + (1 if r > 0 else 0)
    partial_size = full_size - 1
    num_full = length - partial_size * num_lists
    partial_start_idx = num_full * full_size
    if full_size > 0:
